CA.name: California
CA.citation: CDTFA guidance states California economic nexus applies when sales of tangible merchandise for delivery in California exceed $500,000 in the preceding or current calendar year.

NY.name: New York
NY.citation: New York Tax Department guidance requires more than $500,000 in gross receipts and more than 100 sales transactions into New York.

TX.name: Texas
TX.citation: Texas Comptroller remote seller guidance references the $500,000 safe harbor amount and permit FAQ references $500,000 or more in Texas revenue in the past 12 months.

FL.name: Florida
FL.citation: Florida Department of Revenue registration guidance states out-of-state retailers must collect and remit sales tax on remote sales into Florida if taxable remote Florida sales exceeded $100,000 over the previous calendar year.

WA.name: Washington
WA.notes: Washington retail sales tax source archived, but economic nexus threshold source has not yet been archived. Do not use the prototype $100,000 threshold until sourced.
